method: TTM = FY2025 + 9M FY2026 - 9M FY2025 where available. Owner-cash deliberately keeps SBC as a real compensation cost; mechanical OCF-capex is diagnostic only because OCF adds back SBC.

capital_allocation_diagnostics.note: Average-price diagnostics divide cash repurchase spend by disclosed approximate shares and may differ from trade-date accounting.

interpretation: The headline OCF-capex figure materially exceeds normalized owner cash because stock compensation is added back in OCF. Using it directly would double-count SBC economics.
Adobe is close to net-debt neutral and can fund repurchases, AI R&D and smaller acquisitions from internally generated cash.
Net diluted shares declined about 6.8% YoY in Q3, so current repurchases more than offset equity compensation dilution.
